sources.entry: Dovecot - IMAP and POP3 server written primarily with security in mind. (Source Code) MIT/LGPL-2.1 C/deb

summary.one_liner: Dovecot is an IMAP and POP3 mail server, written primarily with security in mind, whose core source code is hosted in this repository.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly points elsewhere: installation steps are in an INSTALL.md file, configuration documentation is referenced (the link itself is missing from the text), and a list of implemented RFCs is provided separately. It names a Dovecot mailing list for questions. Based on the listing metadata, this repository holds the source for an IMAP and POP3 server. The README itself does not describe specific features in detail.
use_cases: Serving email to mail clients over IMAP
Serving email to mail clients over POP3
Running a self-hosted mail server for mailboxes
how_to_run: See INSTALL.md in the repository for installation steps
notable: Written primarily with security in mind (per listing description)
Supports IMAP and POP3 mail retrieval
Implements a set of RFCs, listed separately in the project docs
caveats: README is minimal; installation and configuration details are in separate files or external docs
Support is through a mailing list rather than an issue-based channel mentioned in the README
